summary: legal checked in 5 executive handoff item(s)

items.summary: Legal disposition: blocked for SearchWoot public beta/full launch; keep private and preview-only. Woot documentation proves API access but not redistribution, storage, historical derivatives, public display, alerts, affiliate, or advertising rights; current public terms point against the proposed use. Security, accuracy/freshness, measurement, attribution, and owner gates are also incomplete. Human counsel is required before any rights outreach or launch change.

Fleet compliance disposition: conditional for ordinary reversible growth, blocked for new public exposure or security-sensitive releases. Compliance baseline is 35 pass, 20 fail, 6 unknown, with 20 open banner/consent/GA4 findings and 4 privacy/terms findings. Do not treat incomplete telemetry as a general growth blocker, but preserve site-specific disclosure, consent, affiliate, provenance, claims, copyright/trademark, platform-policy, and age-sensitive boundaries.

Keep complicated.work, deadlymaracas.com, and driveford.net parked, private, preview-only, and unlaunched. No publish, deploy, DNS, analytics configuration, monetization, spend, dependency addition, or queue entry is cleared. Next evidence action: attach dated ownership, preview/build, compliance, security, measurement-boundary, rollback, and explicit-blocker evidence to each existing readiness packet.

No go-live proposal is supported. Retain the existing allthingsmasonic.com CTA refinement as capacity-gated only; preserve disclosures and accessibility and measure affiliate clicks only after CTO releases a slot. Do not claim revenue, ROI, margin, or causal lift from the available aggregate Amazon data.

items.title: Maintain SearchWoot private gate and complete launch evidence
items.summary: Keep SearchWoot private and preview-only while rights, privacy, consent, data-flow, security, accuracy, attribution, measurement, and owner evidence remain incomplete.
items.requested_action: Approve continuation of existing report-only evidence work; keep public beta and full launch blocked until the decision rule is satisfied.
